0022600140.text: The New Orleans Pelicans, who are 0-3 and on a three-game losing streak, host the Denver Nuggets, who are 1-1 and 7th in the West, in the Pelicans' fourth game of the 2026-27 season. Yves Missi is out for New Orleans with a knee bruise, and Denver is missing Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring). Denver leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after winning 141-135 in Denver, and the Pelicans lost all three meetings in the 2025-26 season.
